notes.title: New Steam page, new demo 🦊 Wishlist Harmony in the Wild today! ✨🌿
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to announce that [b]Harmony in the Wild[/b] now has a brand-new Steam page, and with it, a new and improved demo! 🎉

🚨 This demo is NOT on the old page, it’s [b]only available on our new page[/b]. If you’ve followed us before, make sure to wishlist on the new page so you don’t miss out on promotions and updates leading to launch!

✨ [b]What’s new?[/b]
✅ Loads of new content, such as visual effects (Day & Night cycle, Northern Lights, Transformation Effects and more), animal friends, art, sound effects
✅ Updated mechanics, Bug-fixes & gameplay improvements
✅ A more polished world to explore
✅ A fresh start for Harmony in the Wild on Steam!

👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360850/Harmony_in_the_Wild/]Wishlist & Play the New Demo Now![/url]

Your support means so much to us, creating our first professional project has had a lot of challenges along the way and we couldn't have got past them without your help! 
Wishlisting helps us get discovered and bring Harmony in the Wild to more players 💛

Thank you, and we hope you enjoy the new demo! 🦊🌿
